fichas.title: Electrical installation and high-voltage plant
fichas.summary: Describes the hospital substation, emergency power generation and room-based battery backup, and separate star-shaped distribution of general and emergency power. The substation should be centrally located with road access, ventilation, and protection from flood risk; switchgear, transformers, generators, and distribution boards require dedicated rooms.
uses: Transform and distribute the public mains supply
Provide emergency power to defined equipment during mains failure
Provide backup power for operating-theatre lighting and vital medical devices
Distribute general and emergency supplies separately

dimensions.label: Public medium-voltage mains supply
dimensions.context: Voltage range of the public medium-voltage mains network supplying the hospital.

dimensions.label: Low-voltage supply
dimensions.context: Voltage after transformation at the hospital substation.

cross_refs: Regulations for Building Electrical Service Rooms

fichas.title: Telecommunications and IT
fichas.summary: Outlines hospital telecommunications and IT infrastructure, including central telecommunications and server rooms, backup IT provision, structured star-shaped cabling, patient-room communication systems, alarms, surveillance, and central control. It also describes networked workstations and the high network-capacity demands of radiology.
uses: Support patient care and hospital administration with telephone and data networks
Distribute telephone, IT, and medical-technology connections
Provide patient calls, staff communications, and patient media access
Support fire alarms, access control, camera monitoring, and lift surveillance
Record and access clinical and patient data
Connect imaging systems and support radiology data processing

dimensions.label: Telecommunications room size
dimensions.context: Stated size for the central telecommunications room and at least one server (IT) room.
dimensions.ocr_raw: each with a size of 35–70 m²
